Research sample of mergers with a full observation window

Source: R/matching.R
merger_sample.Rd

Keeps merger cases of the given types whose recipient filed a return in every year from -pre to +post around its merger year (on its own fiscal calendar), and adds baseline measures for both organizations, averaged over the years years_back before the merger (years present only; the year -min(years_back) is required for the baseline to count). Donors cannot be observed after the merger, so the donor window is reported (DONOR_PRE_OK: returns in every year -pre to -1) but not required.

Usage

merger_sample(
  cases,
  panel,
  types = "merger2",
  pre = 2L,
  post = 2L,
  years_back = 2:3
)

Arguments

cases

Merger cases (build_merger_cases(), the cases element of build_merger_data()).

panel

Full 990 panel (get_panel()).

types

Merger types to keep.

pre, post

Years required before and after the recipient's merger year.

years_back

Years before the merger used for the baseline.

Value

A list with:

  • sample: one row per case, with R_* (recipient) and D_* (donor) baseline measures, R_NTEE, R_NTEE2, DONOR_PRE_OK, and R_OTHER_EVENTS (other merger cases involving the recipient within the window);

  • baseline: the underlying organization-years (donor and recipient at each of years_back), long format;

  • treated: one row per recipient and merger year, the units to match.
